purpose: Repair the confirmed exact-main BACKUP_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE blocker by allowing the installed root-only REG.RU controller wrapper to resolve exactly one existing protected external backup attestation locally before delegating activation, without exposing its path or contents and without introducing new infrastructure or recurring cost.
requiredBehavior: search only bounded local REG.RU roots for existing external backup evidence
accept exactly one regular non-symlink root-owned evidence file
require protected permissions, bounded size and exact STATUS=PASS
fail closed when multiple valid evidence files are discovered
export only a base64 encoded local path to the existing protected core process
never publish the evidence path, contents, model token or private key
preserve exact-main checkout and installed-wrapper hash authority
preserve explicit rollback and redacted failure evidence
forbiddenCapabilities: accepting symlinked, non-root-owned, world-readable or oversized evidence
publishing backup evidence paths or contents
bypassing the existing full-stack STATUS=PASS check
